spec2def(cabview.dll cabview.spec)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# cabview.dll is all Rust (cabview-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cabview-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# cabview.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/cabview-rust/src/cabview/cabview_cpp_h.rs)
# extract.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/cabview-rust/src/cabview/extract_cpp_h.rs)
# folder.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/cabview-rust/src/cabview/folder_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(cabview_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cabview_shims PRIVATE uuid cpprt atl_classes libcabinet liboleaut32 libole32 libshlwapi libcomctl32 libshell32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(cabview_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_target_cpp_properties(cabview_shims WITH_EXCEPTIONS)
add_cargo_module(cabview cabview-cargo cabview.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE cabview-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS cabview_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk)
